claims.explanation: No fact supports the claim that NimbuPay is India's fastest UPI app. F-002 mentions an average confirmation time, but this does not establish it as the fastest overall.
The claim states 5 million users, but F-001 indicates NimbuPay has 4.2 million registered users, which is a lower number.
The claim mentions a guaranteed ₹200 cashback, but F-004 states new users get up to ₹100 cashback, which is a lower maximum.

claims.quote: Pay your bills, split dinners and send money home in seconds
claims.explanation: F-008 confirms support for bill payments, but there is no fact supporting the ability to split dinners or send money home. F-002 mentions payments confirming in about 2 seconds, but this doesn't cover all aspects of the claim.

issues.title: Too many exclamation marks
issues.explanation: The draft uses three exclamation marks, which violates the rule of using at most one exclamation mark per piece. This creates a hyped tone.

issues.title: Competitor comparison
issues.explanation: The draft directly compares NimbuPay to PhonePe, which violates the rule against naming competitors.

issues.quote: It's a no-brainer, so download now before the offer ends!
issues.title: Pressure and urgency
issues.explanation: This phrase creates pressure and urgency, urging the user to download immediately before an offer expires, which violates the rule against fear, shame, or pressure.
